scope: Read-only native geometry capture of the exact public DS54 property-list recipe without Sprintique CSS or runtime. No DS/product fix, no persistence/permissions/human acceptance, no pass oracle for the known clipping defect.
comparisons: The final two profiles hold container width and font fixed while changing viewport width; they distinguish a viewport-only explanation.
The 120px label track is measured in every profile alongside each actual font size and text extent; observations do not claim a full factorial ablation of container/font effects.

An ordinary select and date field outside .iq-properties use identical selected data and the same host width/font. They isolate the additional property-list contract without changing or overriding any DS rule.

fixture.data: Deterministic synthetic labels and values; authored static rows are not evidence of actual Task permissions.
editable: Owner searchable iq-select with avatar and long selected name
fixture.construction: Only registered public custom elements, supported options/value attributes or properties, public ui.personAvatar and documented static property markup. No copied internal component HTML and no production imports.

measurements: Container and row rectangles, computed grid tracks, row gaps/heights, root/control font sizes, line heights, fixed/min/max heights, white-space, overflow and text-overflow.

Complete label/selected/static text and DOM Range boxes for every visible text node and grapheme, with the ancestors that can clip them; off-viewport content is distinguished from clipping inside a row.
Canvas actualBoundingBox metrics may estimate ink boxes when compatible with the DOM text font box; these are explicitly estimates and screenshots remain necessary to judge painted glyph clipping.
Native input full value and canvas text metrics, padding and scroll range; a native single-line edit buffer is not promised to become multiline.

Label/value and adjacent-row text range intersections, content extending outside its row/container, whole-element horizontal scroll ranges and ellipsis candidates; findings are observations, not acceptance passes.
Viewport PNG and full-document PNG captured without focus/scroll repair; the full-document image does not claim all content fits the initial viewport.

capture_contract.required: All four exact profiles mount the expected public component types and literal data, remain free of page/bootstrap errors and off-origin requests, and preserve raw geometry/images even on failure.
capture_contract.target_acceptance: NOT_RUN; this experiment has no target no-clipping oracle and does not approve a future fix.

environment.text_scaling: HTML root font-size exactly 16px or 32px, not browser zoom
environment.load_mode: Vite compiled static preview of exact public DS imports

not_run: New DS version or CSS candidate
A new actual Task render; existing immutable actual Task evidence is supplied by the discovery
Interactions, persistence, authentication and actual read-only permissions
Human evaluation and pixel-exact glyph-mask analysis
True browser zoom, Safari, Firefox, iOS touch and screen readers
